content.short: Solayer is a native restaking layer on Solana that provides stake-weighted Quality of Service (QoS) for dApps.
content.description: Solayer is a pioneering decentralized restaking protocol built natively on the Solana blockchain, designed to enhance network security and provide guaranteed performance for decentralized applications. By allowing users to restake native SOL or Liquid Staking Tokens (LSTs) such as JitoSOL, the protocol issues sSOL, a highly composable liquid derivative. This approach enables participants to earn multiple layers of yield while securing external modules like oracles and bridges. A unique value proposition is its 'Stake-Weighted QoS' mechanism, securing dedicated network bandwidth.
content.meta: Solayer provides native restaking and stake-weighted Quality of Service on Solana. Discover Solayer and more DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
